observations: Hesselman et al. Swedish cohort study, published 2015; compared uterine rupture by single- versus double-layer cesarean closure among women attempting vaginal birth after one prior cesarean.

entities.name: Closure rupture estimate
observations: In a Swedish cohort of 7,683 women attempting vaginal birth after one cesarean, 103 (1.3%) had uterine rupture; single- versus double-layer closure OR 1.17 (95% CI 0.78–1.76), with no statistically significant difference.
Observational estimate is imprecise; the confidence interval includes both no increase and a potentially meaningful increase.
